title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1967-05-05
source: Don Wolfe's 3.75 ips > Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a rare 1967 gem, featuring beautiful playing and an early Jimi‑Hendrix‑inspired vibe.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding version of this era, delivering crystal‑clear sound that lets listeners hear the band’s evolution at the dawn of the Summer of Love. Musically the set is described as beautiful and great, with a noticeable Hendrix influence that sets it apart from earlier 1967 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review highlights both an outstanding performance and top‑tier soundboard quality, leading to a high rating but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as the best‑sounding version of this period; crystal‑clear and well balanced with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, showcasing the band's developing psychedelic edge and early Hendrix influence.
